site.name: Life Celebration Centre
site.org: Deliverance Church International – Life Celebration Centre (LCC), Nakuru
site.mission: Life Celebration Centre exists to reconcile people to God, equip them for Ministry to God and the people with a transformative agenda.

services.note: Sunday service times are being confirmed with the church office. Please call 0722 864 864 before your first visit.

items.name: Sunday Services
items.detail: Multiple services (a Second Service is streamed on YouTube)

giving.note: Verified giving details will be published here once confirmed by the LCC church office. To give today, please give in person during a service or call the church office on 0722 864 864.

leadership.name: Rev. Elijah Mwangi
leadership.bio: Rev. Elijah Mwangi leads Life Celebration Centre and convenes the annual Cutting Edge Conference. His messages are shared weekly on the LCC YouTube channel.

ministries.name: One Accord Ministers
ministries.text: LCC's worship ministers, whose covers of songs such as “Adonai”, “U Mwema” and “Worthy is the Lamb” are shared on our YouTube channel.

ministries.name: Youth Ablaze
ministries.text: A night of worship for young people. Dates are announced on our Facebook page.

ministries.name: Morning Devotion
ministries.text: Short devotional encouragement to start the week, shared online.

ministries.name: CityAnnex
ministries.text: Featured in our social media highlights. Details to be confirmed by the church office.

ministries.name: Cutting Edge Conference
ministries.text: Our annual international conference for ministers and believers, convened by Rev. Elijah Mwangi.

events.title: Cutting Edge Conference 2027
events.place: Deliverance Church LCC, Kariba Road, Freehold, Nakuru
events.summary: Theme: Commissioning for the Global Mission. With Rev. Elijah Mwangi (convener), Bishop Steve Kamau (USA), Bishop Darnell Williams (USA) and Rev. George Macharia (Kenya).

news.title: 55 Trees for 55 Years
news.summary: Deliverance Church marked its anniversary by planting 55 trees, one for every year. Watch the celebration on YouTube.

news.title: “Rejesha” — Njoki Munyi live at LCC
news.summary: Gospel artist Njoki Munyi's live performance of “Rejesha” at LCC Nakuru, one of the most-watched videos on our channel.

news.title: Cutting Edge Conference 2027 dates announced
news.summary: The conference returns 30 March – 4 April 2027 under the theme “Commissioning for the Global Mission”. Registration is open on the official conference website.

notice.text: Cutting Edge Conference 2027 · 30 Mar – 4 Apr · Registration open
